This feature is available globally to Business, Enterprise, Edu, and K-12 users, and to ChatGPT Free, Go, Pro, and Plus users.
ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets is a spreadsheet-native AI experience that lives in a sidebar inside your Excel and Google Sheets spreadsheets. It can help you build, update, and explain spreadsheets directly, including large, multi-tab files with formulas, references, and assumptions. ChatGPT for Excel and ChatGPT for Google Sheets are separate spreadsheet experiences, but they support similar workflows: creating spreadsheets from scratch, asking questions about existing spreadsheets, and making updates using natural language.
You can also use Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app to work directly with an open Microsoft Excel workbook through the ChatGPT for Excel add-in. Codex can inspect and update sheets, formulas, values, formatting, and charts in the workbook. It can also use code and local files you provide as part of the task. This workflow is currently available for Microsoft Excel only. To get started:

ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets are available globally to Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu, and K-12 users. Free and Go include limited usage access. Plus and Pro include access subject to your plan's agentic usage limit. Business, Enterprise, Edu, and K-12 customers have a free preview through June 2, 2026; after that, usage follows each plan's credits and usage terms. Agentic usage limits are shared with other agentic features once pricing for those features is effective. For effective dates and feature-specific pricing, see Using Credits for Flexible Usage in ChatGPT for Plus and Pro or the ChatGPT Rate Card for Business and Enterprise. Usage depends on the size and complexity of the spreadsheet task. Larger workbooks, multi-step edits, and more complex analysis may use more of your agentic usage limit. Business and Enterprise admins can monitor usage and purchase credits for additional access.
ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets supports workspace-level enterprise controls including data and inference residency where available, Enterprise Key Management, and role based access controls. Prompts and responses are available in the Compliance API. For technical details, please see the Compliance API reference .
ChatGPT for Excel runs in Microsoft Excel. ChatGPT for Google Sheets runs in Google Sheets. Your use of those products is governed by your agreements with Microsoft or Google, respectively. As part of Microsoft's Add In Marketplace Terms of Service , Microsoft may have the ability to read the content of your Excel workbook, attachments, and prompts. What gets processed: To respond, ChatGPT processes your prompt, attachments, and relevant spreadsheet context so it can update your workbook and send you an analysis. Your data is stored locally in the product, and you can delete or download your data directly in the Settings. Some of your data logs may be stored with OpenAI for 30 days for safety and integrity purposes.
ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets is available globally to Business, Enterprise, Edu, and K-12 users, and to ChatGPT Free, Go, Pro, and Plus users.
Can it connect to my other apps or internal systems?
Yes. Where apps are supported, availability depends on your ChatGPT plan, admin settings, user permissions, and data-source entitlements. If an app is not available, check with your workspace admin.
Yes. ChatGPT for Excel runs in Microsoft Excel, and ChatGPT for Google Sheets runs in Google Sheets. Your use of those products is governed by your agreements with Microsoft or Google, respectively.
What are Skills in ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets?
Skills are reusable playbooks for spreadsheet work. They can encode workflows, standards, formatting rules, and output structures so users do not have to rebuild the same prompt each time.
ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets include default Skills for financial modeling and corporate finance formatting. More Skills may be added over time.
Open ChatGPT in Excel and Google Sheets, select + to browse Skills, then select a Skill or invoke it with @ in your prompt.
What are apps in ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets?
Apps let ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets use approved files, systems, and data sources from your ChatGPT account so it can produce more contextual spreadsheet outputs.
Are all ChatGPT apps available in ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets?
Apps from a user's ChatGPT account can carry over to ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets, subject to admin controls, user permissions, and data-source entitlements. For MCP apps, tools intended for use in ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets should be accurately annotated as read-only and non-destructive. Tools without explicit annotations may be handled conservatively and may not appear in these surfaces.

ADD-IN ERROR This add-in could not be started. Close this dialog to ignore the problem or click “Restart” to try again.
This can happen during the SSO callback when an older SSO callback URL redirects to OpenAI’s current SSO endpoint. Browser sign-in may still work, but the Windows Office add-in may not complete this redirect reliably. A Global admin for your tenant should retrieve the ACS URL from:
Then update the OpenAI Enterprise Application in the Identity Provider and make this new URL the default.
